hypothesis: R131 双袖风险平价在 2018-2026 的收益和回撤已通过多轮验证，但逐笔交易级集中度尚未审计。如果 A/B 两袖的逐笔 P&L 在按月度风险平价权重和波动率目标暴露缩放后仍满足 C2-C4，则 R131 可进入纸面交易；否则只能作为研究候选。

method.portfolio: 60d inverse-vol risk parity [0.2,0.8], 15% vol target [0.2,1.0], monthly
method.attribution: A trade P&L x weight_a(entry month) x vol-target exposure(entry month) + B trade P&L x (1 - weight_a(entry month)) x vol-target exposure(entry month); concentration shares are ratio-invariant to the common 1M sleeve capital.

gates.P1: re-run A/B curves match the validated r125/r119 caches after rebasing; max abs difference <= 1e-6
gates.P2: paper_trade_candidate.py produces a state with all_pass=true
gates.C2: largest symbol share of attributed net P&L <= 25%
gates.C5: at least 8 distinct symbols with positive attributed P&L in the last 12 months
gates.C6: largest industry share of gross profit <= 45%
gates.C7: largest single-symbol loss <= 20% of gross profit

decision_rule: P1/P2/C1-C7 全部通过才把 R131 标记为可进入纸面交易；任一失败则只保留研究候选状态，不得通过放宽门槛或修改归因口径来挽救。纸面交易不等于生产部署。
known_limitations: 逐笔归因使用月度权重和月度暴露，不是逐日现金流复算
A/B 两袖各自以 100 万起始资金回测，组合层按权重缩放是近似
行业分类为当前快照，不是历史 PIT
止盈/止损按日线成交，存在日线口径偏差
